title: Myo-inositol supported heterometallic Dy24M2 (M = Ni, Mn) cages

synthesis.procedure: Nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate, aqueous dysprosium(III) perchlorate and myo-inositol were added to anhydrous ethanol. The mixture was heated to about 70 °C; freshly prepared aqueous NaOH was added dropwise with stirring to pH 6. The solution was refluxed for 2 h and filtered. Evaporation of the filtrate gave block-shaped crystals after two weeks.
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction followed by reflux and filtrate evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; the filtrate was evaporated to afford block-shaped crystals.

properties.summary: The susceptibility decreases on cooling; frequency-dependent out-of-phase AC susceptibility indicates slow magnetic relaxation. The reported relaxation parameters were estimated without frequency-dependent susceptibility peaks.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row; deposition number also stated in main-text synthesis footnote

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Dy24Ni2 cation is a cage assembled from two bowl-like Dy9Ni units linked by three Dy2 units through myo-inositol ligands. Three perchlorate anions occupy the cage interior. A separate [Dy(H2O)9]3+ counterion occurs in the reported formula.

synthesis.procedure: The shared procedure for 1 was used, replacing nickel(II) acetate with manganese(II) acetate tetrahydrate. Manganese acetate, aqueous dysprosium(III) perchlorate and myo-inositol were added to anhydrous ethanol. After heating to about 70 °C, aqueous NaOH was added dropwise with stirring to pH 6. The solution was refluxed for 2 h and filtered; evaporation of the filtrate afforded block-shaped crystals after two weeks.
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction followed by reflux and filtrate evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; the filtrate was evaporated to afford block-shaped crystals.
